title: Straight Conveyor
body:
"ZOOM!"


The Straight Conveyor is a structure that can be bought from The Oak Depot. It is a basic straight section of conveyor belt with small walls.

Details

The Straight Conveyor moves objects in a straight line. Its direction can be toggled by interacting with the slider on the side of the conveyor, allowing it to move objects in either direction, or to disable movement entirely by leaving the switch in the center position.

The Straight Conveyor, when unboxed, is a 6×2×6 object. It can be resized to be as short as 3 studs in length, or as long as 24 studs in length.
